page_title: English Extensive Reading & Comprehensible Input | Story Leaf
meta_description: Start English extensive reading with 842 easy picture books. Read offline, listen to narration and build a daily comprehensible input habit with Story Leaf.
about_body: Story Leaf helps you get comfortable with English by reading lots of easy picture books.

features.title: Tap a word, see it in your language
features.body: Tap any English word in the text and its meaning appears in your own language.

features.title: Natural-sounding narration
features.body: Books are read aloud with natural pronunciation.

features.title: The app grows with you
features.body: When you finish a book, just pick how hard and how fun it was.

features.title: Built to keep you going
features.body: A Story Tree that grows with every book you finish, plus titles earned for books read, words read, daily streaks, and completing a genre.

q4: What are extensive reading and comprehensible input?
a4: Extensive reading means reading plenty of easy, enjoyable material for meaning. Comprehensible input is the broader idea of language you can understand, through reading, listening and more. Easy stories and narration offer ways to put those ideas into practice.
q5: How do I start an extensive reading habit?
a5: Choose books you can follow without constant dictionary lookups. Enjoy the story, skip difficult parts, and change books if one is too hard or uninteresting. Use narration when helpful and gradually read and listen more at your own pace.
